note: soterScore is P(attack) AS PRODUCTION REPORTS IT, rounded to 4 decimals (onnxBackend.ts:673). soterScoreExact is the same value before rounding, captured from production's own decide()/attackProbability() for the window production selected, and verified to round back to soterScore on every row. Use the exact score for any low-FPR comparison. soterAction is the real two-tier decision. Row order matches the battery file exactly, so `i` is the join key.
